title: I fixed a bad product page with AI (full prompt)
caption: The exact 2 prompts I use to turn a dead product page into one that answers every buyer question. Screenshot them. #shopify #productpage #aitools #ecommerce

beats.headline: This page is *losing sales.*
beats.say: This product page is *losing* sales. Let me fix it with AI, live, with the exact prompts.

beats.headline: The *before*
beats.say: [dissatisfaction-hnn] *Generic* title. One photo. No reviews. And a wall of text nobody reads.

beats.headline: It answers | *nothing.*
beats.say: It doesn't answer a single *question* the buyer has.

beats.headline: Two prompts. | Zero *copywriter.*
beats.say: Three steps. Two prompts. No copywriter *needed.*

visual.prompt: Act as a skeptical first-time buyer. Here's my product page. List the top 5 reasons you would NOT buy.
reply: 2. Will it work for my skin?

beats.say: Step one. *Paste* your page into any AI chat and say: act as a skeptical first-time buyer, list the top five reasons you would not buy. It finds them: price, fit, trust, delivery, and *returns.*
Step two. Every objection becomes a *section.* Price gets a bundle and a guarantee. Fit gets a who-it's-for line. Trust gets reviews at the top. Delivery gets a ship date. Returns get a badge.

visual.prompt: Rewrite this page. Benefit-first headline. 3 bullets in my customers' words. Answer all 5 objections.
reply: • Love it or your money back

beats.say: *Ask* it to rewrite the page: a benefit-first headline, three bullets in your customers' words from real reviews, and an answer to every objection.
Bonus: swap it in for a week and compare sales. Let the *data* decide, not your opinion.

beats.headline: Less hype. | More *answers.*
beats.say: Buyers don't need more hype. They need *answers.*

beats.say: *Screenshot* those two prompts, and follow for more AI store fixes.
